# 🗂️ Stack Catalog & Data Provenance

The authoritative index of every dashboard on this stack — descriptions, live
health snapshots, and links — plus the **InfluxDB source-provenance audit**
(which buckets are cloud-duplicated and which are local-only). The directory and
audit are generated from `grafana/dashboards.index.d/`, the source of truth; the
**All dashboards (live)** list and the stat row below update in real time.

panels.title: InfluxDB storage
panels.description: Total on-disk size across all buckets (bucket_stats).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bucket_stats" and r._field == "disk_bytes")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bucket_stats" and r._field == "disk_bytes")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Write rate
panels.description: Total points/sec written across all buckets.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bucket_stats" and r._field == "points_per_sec")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Total series
panels.description: Sum of series cardinality across buckets.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bucket_stats" and r._field == "series")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Most recent local InfluxDB backup result (ops `backup`).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: -72h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "backup" and r._field == "success" and r.target == "local")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Anomalies
panels.description: Anomaly points flagged over the selected range (ops `anomaly`).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "anomaly" and r._field == "zscore")
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

options.content:
## 🔎 InfluxDB source-provenance audit
_Which buckets duplicate data already in the cloud, and whether they could be served from Cloudflare directly. Audited 2026-06-04._

| Bucket | Origin | Cloud copy? | Replace w/ Cloudflare direct? |
|---|---|---|---|
| **campsites** | R2 summaries (`campsite-raw`) | ✅ Cloudflare — R2 raw + Analytics Engine | ⚠️ Already hybrid; Influx is the aggregation + history layer, not a dupe |
| **mountain** | is-the-mountain-out (CF Worker + R2) | ✅ likely Cloudflare | ⚠️ Maybe — but ~1.5 KB / 3 series, negligible |
| **tempest_archive** | WeatherFlow station | ☁️ WeatherFlow cloud (not CF) | ❌ Different vendor; Influx is the archive |
| **transit_tracker** | OneBusAway realtime API | ☁️ Realtime only, no upstream history | ❌ Influx is the *only* history |
| **home_assistant** | HA Pi over LAN | ❌ Local | ❌ |
| **claude_code** | Local Claude Code telemetry | ❌ Local | ❌ |
| **system** | Telegraf host metrics | ❌ Local | ❌ |
| **zigbee_archive** | zigbee2mqtt over LAN (empty) | ❌ Local | ❌ |
| **ops** | Internal heartbeats (backup/anomaly/bucket-stats) | ❌ Local | ❌ |

**Verdict:** Only **`campsites`** (marginally `mountain`) has a Cloudflare-side copy; the other seven are
local-origin or cloud-from-another-vendor where Influx is the sole durable archive. **No redundant ingest to cut.**
The campsites Influx bucket isn't duplication — it's the retention + aggregation layer Cloudflare deliberately doesn't
provide (Analytics Engine retention is ~3 months; scanning the ~1.5M raw points live is too slow / OOM-risky on the
2 GB Influx, so `ingest.py` pre-aggregates). See [campsite-availability](/d/campsite-availability) and the
`cloud_provenance` block in `dashboards.index.d/`.
